zh: 孩子坐成一圈，玩具一个一个按编号递增方向发下去，本质上就是在环上从 D 出发往前走若干步。
第一个玩具在 D 手里不需要移动，之后每个玩具都往前移动一位，总共移动 T−1 次；环形编号可以用对 N 取模来处理，先把编号改成从 0 开始更方便。
把起点换成 0 起的 D−1，加上 T−1 后对 N 取模，再加 1 转回 1 起编号，即 (D − 1 + T − 1) mod N + 1；数值可到 2×10^9，用 64 位整数计算。
en: The children sit in a circle and toys are handed out one by one in increasing order of number, so this is just walking forward around a ring starting from D.

The first toy goes to D without moving, and every later toy moves one seat forward, for T-1 moves in total; the circular numbering is handled by taking the result modulo N, which is easiest with 0-based numbers.
Convert the start to the 0-based D-1, add T-1, take it modulo N, and add 1 to return to 1-based numbering: (D - 1 + T - 1) mod N + 1; the intermediate value can reach 2*10^9, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Renumber the children from 0. The first toy is at d−1; move forward T−1 more seats and take the result modulo N.

## Proof of correctness

The first toy, starting at D, needs no move; each later toy moves forward by one seat. That is T−1 moves in total, the circular numbering corresponds to taking the result modulo N, and finally convert back to 1-based numbering.

## Complexity

O(1) time, O(1) space.
